name: Spodumene ore; open pit mining; at plant; 1.89% lithium oxide ore grade
description: This unit process produces spodumene ore of 1.89% lithium oxide (Li2O) grade using open pit mining . The functional unit of the process is the production of 1.89% Li2O grade spodumene ore that will be sent to a beneficiation plant for further processing. The gate-to-gate system boundary includes operation of diesel powered drilling rigs, blasting, transport of waste rock and transport of spodumene ore out of the mine, as well as loading and unloading. The process does not have co-products and all the environmental impacts are allocated to spodumene production.
category: 21: Mining, Quarrying, and Oil and Gas Extraction/2123: Nonmetallic Mineral Mining and Quarrying

processDocumentation.timeDescription: The diesel consumption parameters are taken from report published in 2011 and blasting parameters have been obtained from ecoinvent database v3.10.
processDocumentation.geographyDescription: This process represents spoduemene ore from typical Canadian lithium hard rock source, representative of Canadian context. However, the process may be used in other regions that use open pit mining for spodumene ore.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: Open pit mining of spodumene ore using drilling rigs and blasting. The transport of waste rock and transport of spodumene ore out of the mine, as well as loading and unloading are included.
processDocumentation.inventoryMethodDescription: Attributional and gate to gate process.
processDocumentation.modelingConstantsDescription: The dataset is entirely based on third party reports and databases.
processDocumentation.completenessDescription: Elementary flows are cut-off at less than 1% based on environmental relevance. Technosphere flows are cut-off at less than 1% based on environmental relevance. The mass balance for this process was not calculated.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Diesel consumption is based on typical Canadian spodumene mine estimate. The blasting data points are based on ecoinvent database.
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: Emissions by diesel-based machinery were estimated using an emission factor of 2.68 kg CO2/Liter and consumption of diesel by the mining opreation.
processDocumentation.samplingDescription:
Boundary conditions: The gate-to-gate system boundary includes operation of diesel powered drilling rigs, blasting, transport of waste rock and transport of spodumene ore out of the mine, as well as loading and unloading. 
Data collection: Data were collected from industry sources and literature.
Uncertainty: Uncertainty was not evaluated for this process.
processDocumentation.useAdvice: This process was developed to be an input to lithium hydroxide monohydrate production.

reviews.details: The dataset and resulting carbon footrpint values were compared to published results in scientific literature.

reviewers.name: Miyuru Kannangara, National Research Council Canada

processDocumentation.intendedApplication:
SITUATION C1 -- ACCOUNTING The intended application for this process is for accounting purposes as described in Goal Situation C1 from the ILCD Handbook’s Detailed Guidance. LCA studies with this intended application offer "purely descriptive documentation of the system under analysis (e.g., a product, sector or country), without being interested in any potential consequences on other parts of the economy.” The studies categorized under Goal Situation C1 do consider existing benefits outside the analyzed system such as recycling.

The intended application is a purely descriptive accounting / documentation of the analysed system including existing interactions with other systems in the LCI model. The target audience of this model includes LCA practitioners, industry, and the general public.
